name: Lyn
price: 26 € / $29.99 one-time with 15 months of updates; 15-day trial
engine: own RAW converter, Metal; QuickTime/AVFoundation player
summary: Long-running lightweight image browser for photographers and designers with a folder sidebar, geotag map, non-destructive editing and sharing to Flickr, Dropbox and SmugMug. Sold directly, runs back to macOS 10.13.

native_apple_silicon.note: 'Hello Apple Silicon' (2.0.2); MacUpdate lists Intel 64 + Apple Silicon

no_account_no_tracking.note: Privacy policy: the application collects analytics (Google Analytics and own), Crashlytics and Sentry crash/usage data. No account needed to buy.
